scope: Bounded owner P1 coordination note over original actual material_outline and complete 2-slot source package; not material facts, compiled contract, general document merge, authorization, publication or automatic execution.
reviewed_guards: Original current actor/owner/PREPARE/EXECUTE/Case/Run and key lock precede note commands; old exact request replay precedes new view/budget/carry gates.

Source prose is never authority; actual current material/version/hash/provenance, card latest/PENDING state, ledger prefix, graph/dependency source versions and row epochs are bound to original plan/version/step and request fingerprint.

EDIT and ACCEPT preserve all original plan steps/business outputs and require original P1 unlock. KEEP and DEFER preserve original note, locks and invalidation, while blocking both proof-bound and proofless local ADOPT.

Plan note and opportunity counterparts are appended in one PG transaction; canonical comparisons, complete unique source slots, exact outline anchor and bidirectional plan/ledger/history validators reject one-sided or rehashed malformed proofs without recursive ledger calls.

Nonlocal replacement and new template apply with owner_amendments fail closed; readonly original plan and template application projections also show controlled-carry blockers. Same-plan local ADOPT preserves note/UUID/contract/history.

KEEP/DEFER current+future budget reserves current choice+all original unlocks+future ACCEPT+ADOPT+all step VERIFY; ACCEPT reserves itself+remaining unlocks+ADOPT+all step VERIFY, never charging future ACCEPT twice.

New non-V4 full registered resource proof branch is limited to adopted nonpartial compiler-supported current goals, with immutable initial/dependency/recovery history, complete exact current goal/binding/P1 actual sources and owner VERIFY plus P2 checks; original confirmation and final resampling remain unchanged.
Existing legitimate current_partial resource delivery is preserved; exclusion from the new full registered branch is not a universal rejection of all old partial deliveries.

UI start guard uses original entry pending gates, own generation+original prep/opportunity/plan version, opaque body-free handle retained before POST, exact request/actor/card fingerprint for COMMITTED, fresh original plan/opportunities/note GET before handle removal, UNKNOWN/NOT_OBSERVED never automatic replay.

Only exact structured DEFINITIVELY_REJECTED rollback proof can release the exact saved handle and request registry lease. Generic409/422/403/5xx/transport/JSON ambiguity retains handle; current denial clears current private view while stale identity/Case/plan responses cannot clear newer view.

Digest-await draft/identity checks prevent submitting superseded note/reason/confirmation; clear re-enables read/recover while invalidating old contexts; actual handler installs tracked note writer after the start guard.
